text: SUMMARY: The meeting covered various topics including additions to the agenda, adoption of minutes, and discussions on tax cancellations and drain plans. The council also addressed unfinished business and new items, including a Rec Center Fundraising Committee and clarity on comments made in chambers. Key outcomes included the approval of tax cancellation bylaw 2601 and the first reading of bylaw 2602 for a drain plan. DETAILED SUMMARY: The meeting began with the Mayor, Patrick Terrien, introducing the agenda and acknowledging the presence of all Councillors. The council then proceeded to discuss additions to the agenda, including a resolution to opt out of WMR and items related to unfinished business, such as the Rec Center Fundraising Committee and clarity on comments made in chambers. The adoption of minutes from the previous meeting was also approved. The main discussion topics included tax cancellations, with Councillor Kaczynski inquiring about the types of taxes being canceled and the process for collecting taxes from businesses that have closed or relocated. The council also discussed a drain plan under section township range, with Councillor Fule asking about the existing drain and its maintenance. The meeting concluded with the approval of the tax cancellation bylaw 2601 and the first reading of bylaw 2602 for the drain plan, as well as the addressing of new business items, including a consent agenda and a discussion on the Springfield Food Bank.
